title: Agent-assisted delivery lab
summary: Practise specifying, implementing, debugging, reviewing, and releasing CRUD changes with a coding agent while owning the result.
outcome: A reviewable portfolio of small changes with explicit acceptance criteria, observed verification, and explanations you can reproduce independently.
prerequisites: Use a separate practice copy of the support-ticket app or another CRUD app. Keep generated data and a known working baseline.
model: Change brief: user action, acceptance examples, non-goals, affected boundaries, and rollback conditions.
Evidence record: baseline commit, proposed diff, failing/passing checks, observed results, tradeoffs, and final commit.
Agent context: repository instructions, installed dependency versions, approved scope, and source references. These guide work but do not replace verification.
boundaries: Human-written acceptance contract → repository inspection → bounded agent change → independent checks and review → reversible release.

milestones.title: Turn a vague feature into a small contract
milestones.brief: Convert a request such as better ticket search into one reviewable change with observable behavior and explicit exclusions.
milestones.explanation: An agent needs a task boundary it can verify. State the user action, representative data, success behavior, and at least one failure case. Separate product decisions from implementation guesses. A good brief narrows uncertainty without prescribing every line of code; it also identifies choices that need a human answer before dependent work begins.
steps: Write your own examples for case-insensitive search, empty input, pagination, and unauthorized results. Choose one slice to implement first.
Ask the agent to inspect existing routes, services, queries, tests, and dependency versions before proposing changes. Compare its file map with your own trace.
Revise the brief into acceptance checks, non-goals, and a small diff plan. Save the baseline and explain how you will detect a regression.

checks.label: The brief describes observable behavior and a concrete failure case.
The proposed files and boundaries are grounded in the repository.
Non-goals keep the first change small enough to review.

milestones.experiment: Give the agent a deliberately ambiguous requirement about archived tickets. Check that it identifies the decision instead of silently choosing a data-loss-prone interpretation.
milestones.review: You should be able to explain the intended result before seeing generated code. Keep assumptions visible and resolve the ones that affect correctness.
milestones.stretch: Repeat the exercise with a different feature and compare the amount of rework caused by missing acceptance examples.

milestones.title: Ground Effect code in the installed version
milestones.brief: Have the agent implement a small Effect operation using examples that match the project's actual package versions and conventions.
milestones.explanation: Plausible API names are not evidence that an API exists. Inspect package versions, source exports, and repository examples before coding. Effect major versions and related packages can differ, so keep a coherent version baseline. A type check validates one part of the work; runtime behavior and dependency construction still need a focused test.
steps: Choose a small operation with one expected error and one service requirement. Record the installed Effect version and the relevant source or documentation reference.
Ask the agent to explain the operation's success, error, and requirements types, then implement it using the existing runtime boundary.
Verify the API symbols, run type checking and a behavior test, and intentionally supply a missing dependency in a test to inspect the failure.

checks.label: Every introduced API is available in the installed version.
The operation's required services are provided at a clear boundary.
Both expected failure and successful behavior are observed.

milestones.experiment: Offer an example from a different Effect major as a tempting reference. Verify the agent notices the mismatch rather than mixing APIs until the compiler is silenced.
milestones.review: Avoid accepting broad casts or any as a substitute for understanding an API. Ask for the exact source example that informed the implementation.
milestones.stretch: Write a short local pattern note that explains the verified operation and its tests for the next change.

milestones.title: Prove a bug before accepting a fix
milestones.brief: Direct an agent through reproducing a CRUD defect, choosing a discriminating experiment, and validating a minimal fix.
milestones.explanation: A failing symptom can have several causes. State at least two hypotheses and choose an experiment that distinguishes them. A regression test should fail on the baseline for the reported reason and pass after the fix. Changing a test to match a new implementation is not equivalent to proving the original behavior is repaired.
steps: Introduce or select a reproducible defect, such as a stale edit overwriting a newer title. Record exact steps and the expected stored state.
Ask the agent for competing hypotheses and a minimal reproduction before any edits. Run the failing check yourself and inspect its failure message.
Implement the smallest justified change, rerun the same check, and test one neighboring behavior. Review test changes separately from product changes.

checks.label: The regression check fails on the original defect for the expected reason.
The same behavioral check passes after the fix.
A neighboring case confirms the fix did not merely suppress the symptom.

milestones.experiment: Suggest catching every error and returning success. Explain how the acceptance test should reject this symptom-hiding workaround.
milestones.review: Save before/after results and the causal explanation. A green command with zero discovered tests is not verification.
milestones.stretch: Recreate a variation of the bug without the agent and identify which invariant the original fix protected.

milestones.title: Review generated CRUD changes adversarially
milestones.brief: Inspect an agent-produced feature for missing authorization, invalid transitions, hidden migrations, and misleading tests before accepting it.
milestones.explanation: Generated code should be reviewed against the contract and the data invariants, not just its readability. Trace a direct request that bypasses the UI and inspect what happens if a dependency fails halfway through. Review migrations, dependencies, and tests as part of the same change because each can introduce behavior outside the visible form.
steps: Create a review checklist tied to the feature: ownership predicate, schema boundary, transaction scope, revision handling, and draft recovery.
Read the diff before the agent's summary. Write concrete findings with a triggering input, expected outcome, and the affected code path.
Add one independent negative test for each substantive finding, then request a narrow correction and review the resulting diff again.

checks.label: Findings describe reproducible behavior rather than vague style preferences.
Direct requests and intermediate failures are included in review.
Corrections are verified with tests independent of the implementation's happy path.

milestones.experiment: Remove an owner predicate from a branch while keeping the UI unchanged. Check whether your review and direct-request test detect the access violation.
milestones.review: Do not use the agent's confidence as evidence. Distinguish confirmed bugs, design tradeoffs, and questions that require product clarification.
milestones.stretch: Review a second implementation of the same contract and compare which tests remain useful without modification.

milestones.title: Refactor a Promise flow into Effect incrementally
milestones.brief: Move one existing async operation into Effect while preserving its observable behavior and keeping the diff easy to evaluate.
milestones.explanation: A library migration is easier to review when it separates behavior changes from structural changes. Capture the current contract, identify expected versus unexpected failures, and extract one boundary at a time. Keep pure transformations ordinary functions where that remains clear. The goal is explicit dependencies and recovery, not wrapping every expression in a new abstraction.
steps: Choose one Promise-based write flow and record its return values, errors, persistence effects, and UI states in contract tests.
Introduce a typed Effect operation and an adapter for the existing dependency. Keep execution at the application edge and preserve the public caller contract where practical.
Run the same tests against old and new implementations, compare the diff, and explain every intentional behavior change separately.

checks.label: Existing observable behavior remains covered by unchanged contract tests.
Expected errors and service dependencies are explicit in the new operation.
The refactor avoids unrelated schema, UI, and dependency changes.

milestones.experiment: Make the dependency reject with an unexpected value and compare both implementations. Verify that the migration does not accidentally turn a real failure into successful empty data.
milestones.review: Ask the agent to justify each abstraction and remove ones without a concrete responsibility. A larger diff is not evidence of deeper learning.
milestones.stretch: Add a live and in-memory Layer, then explain one limitation of the fake that still requires integration testing.

milestones.title: Ship with evidence and reproduce the learning
milestones.brief: Prepare a small CRUD change for release with reproducible verification, a rollback plan, and a final exercise completed without the agent.
milestones.explanation: Release evidence connects the intended behavior to the actual artifact. Record which checks ran, their results, the environment, and any unverified external integration. A rollback plan must consider data written by the new version. Finish by explaining the feature and implementing a small variation yourself so the work develops skill as well as shipping code.
steps: Write a concise change description covering the user-visible result, affected data, verification, and remaining limits. Review the final diff and dependency changes.
Build the artifact, run a smoke journey in the target-like environment, rehearse any migration and rollback, and capture actual outputs without claiming unrun checks.
Close the agent session and implement a small variation from memory. Record where you needed help, then create a focused recall question for that gap.

checks.label: The release description matches the final implementation and observed checks.
Rollback behavior accounts for records created by the new version.
An independent variation demonstrates that you can explain and modify the core rule.

milestones.experiment: Simulate a failed verification command or unavailable provider. Confirm the release notes clearly distinguish passed checks from blocked or unverified behavior.
milestones.review: A deployed URL, a long agent transcript, and a passing build are different forms of evidence. Include the user journey and data invariants that establish the feature's behavior.
milestones.stretch: Repeat the full specify-build-review-release loop on another project with less guidance and compare your error detection and explanation quality.

milestones.title: Specify archived-record search behavior
milestones.brief: Request better ticket search with archived examples.
milestones.explanation: Ambiguous visibility rules must be resolved before coding. A useful agent task describes observable behavior and unresolved decisions before choosing implementation details. Ground the brief in the existing application and keep the first slice small enough to inspect and verify independently.
steps: Inspect the existing search route and seed one active, one archived, and one unauthorized matching ticket.
Write expected results for active archived and unauthorized tickets.
Save the revised brief with exact expected result IDs and compare the agent's proposed file map with the repository.
milestones.experiment: Remove archived policy from the brief. The revised proposal must surface the missing visibility decision instead of inventing a rule.
milestones.review: Read the brief without the generated code. Explain what evidence would prove success and which product assumptions still require an explicit decision.
milestones.stretch: Compare rework between both briefs. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Define the exact bulk action scope
milestones.brief: Select page one then change filter before Delete.
milestones.explanation: Selection semantics determine which records may be deleted. A useful agent task describes observable behavior and unresolved decisions before choosing implementation details. Ground the brief in the existing application and keep the first slice small enough to inspect and verify independently.
steps: Capture selected IDs, current filter, record revisions, and the confirmation text before describing the change.
Specify selected IDs preview and conflict behavior.
Walk the brief through selection changes, a stale record, and a repeated confirmation; record the expected result for each.
milestones.experiment: Insert matching records after preview. New matching records must stay outside selected-only scope unless the user explicitly chose all-matching semantics.
milestones.review: Read the brief without the generated code. Explain what evidence would prove success and which product assumptions still require an explicit decision.
milestones.stretch: Choose all-matching versus selected-only semantics. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Specify useful empty and error states
milestones.brief: Open new workspace then simulate server failure.
milestones.explanation: No data and failed loading are different outcomes. A useful agent task describes observable behavior and unresolved decisions before choosing implementation details. Ground the brief in the existing application and keep the first slice small enough to inspect and verify independently.
steps: Capture the current route's loading, empty, populated, and failed responses before proposing new text.
Write distinct interface acceptance examples.
Review wireframes or acceptance examples for all four states and verify each has a distinct condition and next action.
milestones.experiment: Return malformed successful response. A decode failure must become an error state rather than a successful empty collection.
milestones.review: Read the brief without the generated code. Explain what evidence would prove success and which product assumptions still require an explicit decision.
milestones.stretch: Add offline-state behavior. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Define currency and rounding examples
milestones.brief: Add line-item totals for 0.10 and 0.20.
milestones.explanation: A price feature needs representational rules before arithmetic. A useful agent task describes observable behavior and unresolved decisions before choosing implementation details. Ground the brief in the existing application and keep the first slice small enough to inspect and verify independently.
steps: Find the app's existing money representation and write fixtures for empty input, zero, 0.10, and 0.20.
Specify decimal input storage and display contract.
Calculate expected stored and displayed values independently, then compare the proposed implementation contract with those fixtures.
milestones.experiment: Add a zero-decimal currency. The revised brief must state currency-specific precision instead of assuming every currency uses two decimals.
milestones.review: Read the brief without the generated code. Explain what evidence would prove success and which product assumptions still require an explicit decision.
milestones.stretch: Explain rounding per item versus invoice. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Turn roles into an acceptance matrix
milestones.brief: Add editor and viewer roles to ticket app.
milestones.explanation: Permission language must translate into command outcomes. A useful agent task describes observable behavior and unresolved decisions before choosing implementation details. Ground the brief in the existing application and keep the first slice small enough to inspect and verify independently.
steps: Identify the trusted actor source and list representative records owned by two separate workspaces.
List actor action resource combinations.
Check the matrix against direct service calls as well as route visibility; every allowed and denied row needs an oracle.
milestones.experiment: Hide buttons without endpoint checks. The brief remains incomplete until direct commands reject the forbidden action independently of button visibility.
milestones.review: Read the brief without the generated code. Explain what evidence would prove success and which product assumptions still require an explicit decision.
milestones.stretch: Add stale-role-change scenario. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Define what offline saving promises
milestones.brief: Edit a ticket with network disabled.
milestones.explanation: Queued work cannot be called synchronized prematurely. A useful agent task describes observable behavior and unresolved decisions before choosing implementation details. Ground the brief in the existing application and keep the first slice small enough to inspect and verify independently.
steps: Inspect existing local storage and sync behavior, then draw the allowed pending-to-synced and pending-to-conflict transitions.
Specify local pending synced and conflict states.
Use the brief to predict reload, reconnection, and remote-edit behavior without relying on a generated UI mockup.
milestones.experiment: Reconnect after remote edit. The expected result must preserve the local draft while exposing the competing remote revision.
milestones.review: Read the brief without the generated code. Explain what evidence would prove success and which product assumptions still require an explicit decision.
milestones.stretch: Bound offline queue retention. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Specify keyboard behavior before UI changes
milestones.brief: Add a modal ticket editor.
milestones.explanation: A screenshot cannot define accessible interaction. A useful agent task describes observable behavior and unresolved decisions before choosing implementation details. Ground the brief in the existing application and keep the first slice small enough to inspect and verify independently.
steps: Identify the modal trigger, first editable field, validation summary, submit action, and intended close target.
Write focus open submit error close sequences.
Perform the written keyboard sequence against the current interface or prototype and record focus after each transition.
milestones.experiment: Delete trigger while modal stays open. The contract must name a sensible fallback focus target when the original trigger no longer exists.
milestones.review: Read the brief without the generated code. Explain what evidence would prove success and which product assumptions still require an explicit decision.
milestones.stretch: Include screen-reader status announcements. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Split a large feature into a verifiable slice
milestones.brief: Request full CRM import preview history and undo.
milestones.explanation: A small change must still deliver coherent behavior. A useful agent task describes observable behavior and unresolved decisions before choosing implementation details. Ground the brief in the existing application and keep the first slice small enough to inspect and verify independently.
steps: List the current import boundary and mark which proposed capabilities require new persistence or mutation commands.
Choose preview-only slice with fixture-based outcomes.
Compare the agent plan with the selected preview-only acceptance checks and remove unrelated implementation work.
milestones.experiment: Agent begins implementing undo storage. Record the first out-of-scope file change and revise the task boundary before accepting additional code.
milestones.review: Read the brief without the generated code. Explain what evidence would prove success and which product assumptions still require an explicit decision.
milestones.stretch: Write the next dependent slice. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Keep unresolved assumptions visible
milestones.brief: Request automatic assignment without tie-breaking policy.
milestones.explanation: Agent guesses cannot silently become product requirements. A useful agent task describes observable behavior and unresolved decisions before choosing implementation details. Ground the brief in the existing application and keep the first slice small enough to inspect and verify independently.
steps: Collect two examples that expose the undefined assignment tie-breaker and identify repository inspection that is independent of it.
Record decisions and isolate independent preparatory work.
Produce a decision log separating confirmed requirements, assumptions, and blocked decisions with their dependent tasks.
milestones.experiment: Provide conflicting example expectations. Conflicting examples should remain unresolved in the log until a consistent product decision is provided.
milestones.review: Read the brief without the generated code. Explain what evidence would prove success and which product assumptions still require an explicit decision.
milestones.stretch: Revise the brief with a decision history. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Ground changes in installed Effect versions
milestones.brief: Implement one repository operation in existing app.
milestones.explanation: Documentation from another major version may not apply. Agent context should be evidence from the repository and installed dependencies. Identify the real runtime boundary and service construction, then verify proposed APIs and error behavior with focused compilation and execution.
steps: Read package manifest, lockfile, installed exports, and one local Effect example before drafting the operation.
Record package version and inspect actual exports.
Compile and run the proposed operation against the recorded install, preserving the symbol references used to justify it.
milestones.experiment: Give agent an incompatible example. List the incompatible symbols and explain the supported replacement instead of mixing conventions silently.
milestones.review: Compare the proposed file map and API claims with actual sources. Do not accept a plausible symbol name or a successful mock as proof of integration.
milestones.stretch: Explain required adaptation explicitly. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Trace real service construction
milestones.brief: Add notification adapter to ticket save flow.
milestones.explanation: A declared service must be supplied at runtime. Agent context should be evidence from the repository and installed dependencies. Identify the real runtime boundary and service construction, then verify proposed APIs and error behavior with focused compilation and execution.
steps: Trace the application entrypoint through runtime construction to the ticket save operation and its required services.
Map entrypoint service layer and repository dependencies.
Exercise the production construction and a controlled test replacement, then compare the missing-service failure with expectations.
milestones.experiment: Omit adapter from one runtime path. The omitted adapter must produce a visible construction or execution failure rather than a hidden global fallback.
milestones.review: Compare the proposed file map and API claims with actual sources. Do not accept a plausible symbol name or a successful mock as proof of integration.
milestones.stretch: Document shared versus scoped construction. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Identify expected errors and defects
milestones.brief: Implement rename returning duplicate-name conflict.
milestones.explanation: A type signature should reflect recoverable business outcomes. Agent context should be evidence from the repository and installed dependencies. Identify the real runtime boundary and service construction, then verify proposed APIs and error behavior with focused compilation and execution.
steps: Write a duplicate-name fixture and an unexpected adapter failure before changing the operation's error model.
Explain success error and requirement types.
Compare the inferred success, expected-error, and requirements types with observed UI recovery and defect reporting.
milestones.experiment: Throw unexpected error inside adapter. The unexpected failure must reach the defect-reporting boundary rather than becoming a successful empty result.
milestones.review: Compare the proposed file map and API claims with actual sources. Do not accept a plausible symbol name or a successful mock as proof of integration.
milestones.stretch: Review defect reporting boundary. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Reuse local patterns deliberately
milestones.brief: Add contact service beside existing ticket service.
milestones.explanation: New architecture must fit actual repository conventions. Agent context should be evidence from the repository and installed dependencies. Identify the real runtime boundary and service construction, then verify proposed APIs and error behavior with focused compilation and execution.
steps: Inspect the neighboring ticket service, repository interface, dependency construction, and focused tests before adding contact behavior.
Inspect analogous code before proposing structure.
Review the proposed file organization against actual call sites and document any new abstraction with a concrete consumer.
milestones.experiment: Provide an outdated architecture note. Record which source is current and update the stale guidance separately from the functional change.
milestones.review: Compare the proposed file map and API claims with actual sources. Do not accept a plausible symbol name or a successful mock as proof of integration.
milestones.stretch: Resolve documentation-source disagreement. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Avoid unnecessary package additions
milestones.brief: Agent proposes new validation package for one field.
milestones.explanation: A small CRUD change does not justify speculative dependencies. Agent context should be evidence from the repository and installed dependencies. Identify the real runtime boundary and service construction, then verify proposed APIs and error behavior with focused compilation and execution.
steps: Inventory existing schema, field validation, and form-error utilities relevant to the requested field change.
Check existing schema and form utilities.
Compare a minimal implementation with the proposed dependency approach, including actual import and build impact.

checks.label: Added package has concrete need or is removed.

milestones.experiment: Offer a package with overlapping APIs. The alternative package needs a concrete missing capability; overlapping APIs alone do not justify adoption.
milestones.review: Compare the proposed file map and API claims with actual sources. Do not accept a plausible symbol name or a successful mock as proof of integration.
milestones.stretch: Document maintenance tradeoffs. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Verify a provider adapter against its contract
milestones.brief: Wrap a fake storage provider in an Effect service.
milestones.explanation: Mock behavior must match actual supported operations. Agent context should be evidence from the repository and installed dependencies. Identify the real runtime boundary and service construction, then verify proposed APIs and error behavior with focused compilation and execution.
steps: Create provider-shaped fixtures for success, malformed response, timeout, and permanent rejection using public teaching data.
Document request response and failure mapping.
Run the same adapter contract cases through its Effect boundary and compare domain outcomes with the documented mapping.
milestones.experiment: Return success missing required identifier. A missing provider identifier must not be replaced with an invented receipt or treated as complete acceptance.
milestones.review: Compare the proposed file map and API claims with actual sources. Do not accept a plausible symbol name or a successful mock as proof of integration.
milestones.stretch: Add provider-shaped contract fixtures. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Locate resource lifetime boundaries
milestones.brief: Add database session around import preview.
milestones.explanation: Connections and subscriptions need deliberate release ownership. Agent context should be evidence from the repository and installed dependencies. Identify the real runtime boundary and service construction, then verify proposed APIs and error behavior with focused compilation and execution.
steps: Draw acquisition, readiness, use, interruption, and release for the database session used by preview.
Trace acquire use and cleanup paths.
Count active sessions after success, failure, cancellation, and repeated preview navigation; retained sessions must be explained.
milestones.experiment: Cancel while request is pending. The cancelled request must release its owned session even when the normal success continuation never runs.
milestones.review: Compare the proposed file map and API claims with actual sources. Do not accept a plausible symbol name or a successful mock as proof of integration.
milestones.stretch: Measure concurrent resource use. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Provide enough context without unrelated code
milestones.brief: Ask agent to fix stale search results.
milestones.explanation: Task context should support the actual change boundary. Agent context should be evidence from the repository and installed dependencies. Identify the real runtime boundary and service construction, then verify proposed APIs and error behavior with focused compilation and execution.
steps: Collect the stale-search reproduction, relevant route, query client, service interface, and current package versions.
Provide route query service and current failing fixture.
Compare the agent's proposed race explanation with a manually traced request timeline before accepting implementation work.
milestones.experiment: Omit response ordering example. Record the assumption introduced by missing ordering context and add the smallest fixture that resolves it.
milestones.review: Compare the proposed file map and API claims with actual sources. Do not accept a plausible symbol name or a successful mock as proof of integration.
milestones.stretch: Compare proposed plan quality. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Replace invented APIs with verified usage
milestones.brief: Agent proposes a nonexistent Effect helper.
milestones.explanation: Generated names require source evidence. Agent context should be evidence from the repository and installed dependencies. Identify the real runtime boundary and service construction, then verify proposed APIs and error behavior with focused compilation and execution.
steps: Locate the proposed helper in installed exports and identify the actual composition pattern used by nearby code.
Inspect exports and replace with supported composition.
Compile the replacement and run its success and failure fixtures; keep a source reference for each non-obvious API choice.
milestones.experiment: Use same name from wrong package. A similarly named export from another package must not be imported without verifying its contract and compatibility.
milestones.review: Compare the proposed file map and API claims with actual sources. Do not accept a plausible symbol name or a successful mock as proof of integration.
milestones.stretch: Write a source-linked implementation note. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Reproduce a stale-edit overwrite
milestones.brief: Two tabs edit ticket revision 5.
milestones.explanation: A concurrency regression needs competing revisions. A regression test should fail for the reported behavior and pass for the right reason. Pin meaningful fixtures, avoid mirroring implementation details, and separate application defects from unreliable timing or environment assumptions.
steps: Seed one ticket at revision five and arrange two writers that both read that revision before either saves.
Synchronize requests around the protected write.
Run the regression against the old and fixed paths, asserting final fields, revision, and the losing command's conflict result.
milestones.experiment: Replace concurrency with sequential requests. The sequential variant should be documented as insufficient because it does not expose the shared-read race.
milestones.review: Run the reproducer on the old behavior when possible. Ask whether a deliberately wrong fix could still satisfy the test and strengthen the oracle accordingly.
milestones.stretch: Explain why the weaker test misses the bug. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Reproduce responses arriving backward
milestones.brief: Query Cedar then Birch with delayed Cedar result.
milestones.explanation: Timing tests should control completion order directly. A regression test should fail for the reported behavior and pass for the right reason. Pin meaningful fixtures, avoid mirroring implementation details, and separate application defects from unreliable timing or environment assumptions.
steps: Prepare two controlled query responses and start Cedar before Birch without using real-time sleeps.
Use controllable response promises.
Resolve Birch first and Cedar last, then assert visible IDs and the current query's loading state after both settle.
milestones.experiment: Resolve second request first repeatedly. Repeated reversed completion must produce the same newest-query result rather than a timing-dependent pass.
milestones.review: Run the reproducer on the old behavior when possible. Ask whether a deliberately wrong fix could still satisfy the test and strengthen the oracle accordingly.
milestones.stretch: Add cancellation evidence. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Prove duplicate creation after a lost reply
milestones.brief: Create contact then retry after hidden success.
milestones.explanation: A button test alone cannot cover network retries. A regression test should fail for the reported behavior and pass for the right reason. Pin meaningful fixtures, avoid mirroring implementation details, and separate application defects from unreliable timing or environment assumptions.
steps: Create a command identity and fake transport that hides a committed creation response from the caller.
Use stable command fixture and persisted row count.
Retry through the real persistence boundary and inspect entity rows plus both response identities after settlement.
milestones.experiment: Retry with changed payload. Changed content under the same identity must have an explicit conflict result instead of creating a second entity.
milestones.review: Run the reproducer on the old behavior when possible. Ask whether a deliberately wrong fix could still satisfy the test and strengthen the oracle accordingly.
milestones.stretch: Test operation-identity conflict. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Test authorization beyond hidden buttons
milestones.brief: Viewer calls edit service directly.
milestones.explanation: Endpoint access is the meaningful security boundary. A regression test should fail for the reported behavior and pass for the right reason. Pin meaningful fixtures, avoid mirroring implementation details, and separate application defects from unreliable timing or environment assumptions.
steps: Seed an editor, a viewer, and a foreign workspace record, all with verified identity fixtures.
Create verified identities and scoped fixture records.
Call the service directly for each actor and inspect both returned outcomes and unchanged forbidden records.
milestones.experiment: Remove UI entirely from test. Authorization assertions must still execute and pass without relying on a rendered interface or hidden controls.
milestones.review: Run the reproducer on the old behavior when possible. Ask whether a deliberately wrong fix could still satisfy the test and strengthen the oracle accordingly.
milestones.stretch: Audit alternate mutation routes. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Make expiry behavior deterministic
milestones.brief: Confirm hold at exact expiry instant.
milestones.explanation: Sleeping is an unreliable expiry oracle. A regression test should fail for the reported behavior and pass for the right reason. Pin meaningful fixtures, avoid mirroring implementation details, and separate application defects from unreliable timing or environment assumptions.
steps: Set the authoritative clock immediately before, at, and after a hold's expiry using fixed timestamp fixtures.
Use injectable clock and fixed timestamps.
Run the three cases repeatedly without waiting and compare outcomes with the declared equality rule.
milestones.experiment: Run test under different system zones. Changing machine time zone must not alter instant-based expiry outcomes or the chosen boundary behavior.
milestones.review: Run the reproducer on the old behavior when possible. Ask whether a deliberately wrong fix could still satisfy the test and strengthen the oracle accordingly.
milestones.stretch: Find hidden real-time reads. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Expose partial transactional writes
milestones.brief: Fail activity insertion after ticket update.
milestones.explanation: A response error does not prove rollback. A regression test should fail for the reported behavior and pass for the right reason. Pin meaningful fixtures, avoid mirroring implementation details, and separate application defects from unreliable timing or environment assumptions.
steps: Seed a known ticket revision and configure failure precisely between the required ticket and activity writes.
Inject failure inside actual transaction boundary.
Read both tables through a fresh connection after rejection, then retry without the fault and compare committed evidence.
milestones.experiment: Mock repository as one all-or-nothing call. The coarse mock cannot prove rollback; retain an adapter-level test that observes the intermediate failure point.
milestones.review: Run the reproducer on the old behavior when possible. Ask whether a deliberately wrong fix could still satisfy the test and strengthen the oracle accordingly.
milestones.stretch: Explain what integration coverage adds. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Prove a keyboard focus regression
milestones.brief: Close modal after failed submit.
milestones.explanation: Visible content does not establish usable focus. A regression test should fail for the reported behavior and pass for the right reason. Pin meaningful fixtures, avoid mirroring implementation details, and separate application defects from unreliable timing or environment assumptions.
steps: Record the opener element and the modal's expected focus order before triggering invalid submission.
Record focus sequence with keyboard interactions.
Use keyboard interaction to submit, correct, and close; assert the active element rather than only visible text.
milestones.experiment: Remove trigger while modal is open. Removing the trigger must lead to the documented fallback target rather than leaving focus on the document body accidentally.
milestones.review: Run the reproducer on the old behavior when possible. Ask whether a deliberately wrong fix could still satisfy the test and strengthen the oracle accordingly.
milestones.stretch: Test fallback focus behavior. State the additional invariant first.

milestones.title: Test malformed successful responses
milestones.brief: Return contact list containing invalid identifier.
milestones.explanation: HTTP 200 does not guarantee usable data. A regression test should fail for the reported behavior and pass for the right reason. Pin meaningful fixtures, avoid mirroring implementation details, and separate application defects from unreliable timing or environment assumptions.
steps: Prepare separate fixtures for valid populated data, valid empty data, and malformed data returned with HTTP 200.
